note: IP-neutral. Heists (issue #306): rob an outpost's control room. Read by src/systems/flow/heist.gd. Issue #309: the console in every outpost's control room (src/systems/world/outpost_room.gd). Hold [E] at it for hack.seconds and it drops hack.stash (count of item) at your feet, picked up like a smuggling drop (contraband: the gate's search finds it). It only has something to release while a heist names that outpost (WorldState.heist); otherwise it is locked. reach: metres from the spot in front of the console. The alarm is not touched: being seen raises it as usual and the hack keeps going.

lines.locked: The console is locked. Nothing on it worth taking.
lines.ready: [E] Hold to hack the console (%d s)
lines.wiped: The console is wiped. Nothing left on it.
lines.hacked: The console gives up its stash: %d flasks of %s.
